scope: Assembly of the uniform comparison procedure for Paper 17 thm:main: UniformGroundComparison, and hence the strengthened comparator UniformMainComparison, follow from exactly two statements — a partial recursive source compiler taking the policy program as input and calibrated to the existing compiler on realizing programs (ExactUniformCompiler), and one closed-block decider computable jointly in the near-control parameter (JointNearClosedBlocks). The procedure compiles both terms with the supplied program and runs the fixed decision body of #1427; it halts on every raw input for realizing programs. Proved once for a family of selected controls indexed by a parameter and instantiated at the factorial control and at the near controls. Neither of the two pieces is proved here.
